name: Seireki 2236-nen no Masuko
source:
This is a story about Masuko, the Personal A.I. Secretary System (PASS) for Smart Tools* and her owner, Yotsuba.The day is January 1, 2236 A.D. and the start of the year hasn't gone as well as it could have.
(*It's a really awesome smartphone)

This is a nonsensical story between man and AI that seems heartwarming but may not actually be heartwarming.
There are laughs but there aren't really any tears but in any case, it is a visual novel about how Masuko is cute.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627520/2236_AD_Secretary_Stories/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是关于智能工具*的个人AI秘书系统（PASS）麻子，以及她的主人四叶的故事。公元2236年1月1日，新年开端并不顺利。
（*这是一款非常厉害的智能手机。）

这是一段看似温馨、实际上未必温馨的人与AI之间的荒诞故事。故事里有笑声，却几乎没有泪水；无论如何，这是一部讲述麻子可爱的视觉小说。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627520/2236_AD_Secretary_Stories/]Steam[/url]]
